answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 146514 Country: India Title: Eating on red coloured dining cloth (Dastar Khawan) is sunnah or not or is it mustahab? Question: My question is whether eating on red coloured dining cloth (Dastar Khawan) is sunnah or not or is it mustahab? Answer ID: 146514 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 206/155/B=3/1438) We could not find any such Hadith. However, we do find in Hadith that the dining sheet (Dastar Khawan) of the Holy Prophet Muhammad (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) was of leather. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
